name: Penny's Diner
tagline: A mom-and-pop diner on North Market Street, open around the clock.
about: Penny's Diner at 1051 N Market St in Hearne is a classic mom-and-pop diner serving breakfast and American plates around the clock.
On busy nights, call ahead and your order will be ready when you get there.
hours_source: Hours as listed on Restaurantji; call ahead to confirm.
